title: Fenn, imprisoned in Camp Gallows' stockade for uncovering proof the Company's 40-year-old hanging was unlawful, never got a resolution. Even after I found the true pardon and read it publicly at the gallows glade (clearing the Company's name), his dialogue stayed frozen at 'leave him to the cage' / 'mind the guard doesn't hear the rest of it first' with no new options.
